thread:
Maya: Nautilus asked for a staged cutover from CompetitorX with minimal client changes. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing reconciliation, and on-prem fallback. Can we list tech/legal blockers?
Leo: Quick question  do they expect identical endpoints or just behaviorally compatible responses? Sales said 'drop-in where possible'.
Priya: Engineering risks: 1) tokenization differences causing subtle output drift; 2) their client relies on a custom session header for sticky state; 3) they require HSM/KMS + audit evidence for keys.
Dmitri: For tokenization we can add a lightweight shim that normalizes unicode + whitespace and applies a small token mapping table. That usually reduces drift for generated prompts.
Priya: Session header is doable	we can honor X-Client-Session and route to the same Dedicated worker (sticky routing). Need to validate under high QPS.
Maya: Pricing ask: they'd like delta if we run quantized models. Priya, estimate $/1k tokens + latency hit?
Priya: Ballpark: quantized model on Dedicated ~0.55-0.7x cost vs CompetitorX depending on batch utilization. Latency p50 ~+10%, p95 depends on concurrency (+15-30%). Will add numbers to sheet.
Maya: Legal wants no-training clause + 90d retention. Dmitri, can Private/Dedicated enforce that?
Dmitri: Yes: retention config and no-training flag can be set per-customer on Private & Dedicated; HSM integrations supported with our KMS layer. I'll upload integration notes.
deploy-bot: Presales job created: nautilus-shim-v0 -> staging (job 8821).
Maya: Proposed acceptance: 1) Top-1 intent parity >=95% on their eval set; 2) p95 latency within 25% of CompetitorX; 3) sample billing reconciliation report; 4) contractual no-training + 90d retention. Target 2-week POC.
Leo: Action items: Priya -> baseline runs + cost sheet; Dmitri -> SOC2/KMS excerpt and allowlist IPs; Maya -> coordinate eval set + legal addendum; I'll help with smoke tests.
Priya: Smoke test curl for staging shim:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/nautilus-shim/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Client-Session: 4242" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":128}'
```
Maya: I'll ask Nautilus for the eval set and staging creds today. Marking this thread presales-triage.
